summary: 三组均完成拿起、手持介绍、放回并松手，沿用 Serena 柔和配音与平滑口型。抽查开口、收口和 Wan 段落交界，未见原先的整幅硬切；商品包装文字仍有生成误差，保真验收未通过。
method: Manual inspection of decoded phase frames and native segment boundaries; not OCR, identity recognition, or SyncNet scoring.

products.native_segment_boundary_observation: No obvious whole-frame cut across inspected frames 78–83 and 158–163. Natural blink is visible.
products.packaging_note: Reference and driver already contain incorrect product lettering. Wan reproduces/repaints lettering and cannot establish authentic packaging.
products.lip_dubbing_acceptance: Continuous blending weights and inspected onset/offset closeups passed; precise audio-visual sync not scored.

limitations: Driving footage and reference are generated; no real-capture acceptance was performed.
Target resolution is lower than the previous baseline; this is a stack feasibility prototype, not a controlled maximum-quality benchmark.
A few native segment joins show small adjacent-frame face differences; no obvious whole-frame hard cut in the inspected boundary images.
Group clips are edited together at 8.04 and 16.08 seconds; the final 24.12-second video is not one unbroken generation.
SyncNet, OCR, and identity-recognition scores were not run.
